title: Fix ToolResult contradictory Success/Outcome — compute from Outcome
description:
**Source:** Internal audit Sprint 60 (2026-07-11) — MSA-CORE-001

`ToolResult` is a positional record with both `bool Success` and `OutcomeType Outcome`. Both are independently settable, allowing contradictory states like `new ToolResult(Success: false, Outcome: OutcomeType.Completed)`.

**Recommendation:** Remove the standalone `Success` property from `ToolResult` and compute it from `Outcome`, matching the pattern already used in `ActionOutcome`.
